question: Should ClawHub standardize skill display names on the 40-character policy proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2962, and how should existing over-limit names be handled?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but the issue itself never chose a maximum length or legacy policy; those choices affect public catalog behavior and upgrade compatibility.

options.title: Accept 40 chars with explicit grandfathering
options.body: Adopt the linked PR direction, but require tests and proof that unchanged existing over-limit titles keep working or are intentionally migrated.

options.title: Choose a different limit or migration policy
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers record the desired number and whether existing hosted or GitHub-backed titles should be shortened, rejected, or grandfathered.

options.title: Decline a backend limit for now
options.body: Close or narrow the issue only if maintainers decide this should stay as presentation guidance rather than a stored catalog validation rule.

recommendation.title: Accept 40 chars with explicit grandfathering
recommendation.body: Adopt the linked PR direction, but require tests and proof that unchanged existing over-limit titles keep working or are intentionally migrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest recent history across the shared publish helper, GitHub-backed sync, and release snapshot that the policy would modify.
